# Price Self Storage

> > Affordable self-storage solutions across California with drive-up access, online booking, and flexible month-to-month leases.

Price Self Storage operates multiple facilities throughout California, including Southern California regions (San Diego, Los Angeles, Orange County, Inland Empire) and Northern California. The platform emphasizes convenient online booking, competitive pricing, and specialized storage options including vehicle, RV, and climate-controlled units.
